senses.zh_definition: 山丘；小山，英语 hill 的复数形式。对应的标准马来语为 bukit，必要时用 bukit-bukit 明示复数。
senses.en_definition: Plural of hill: natural elevations of land above their surroundings; also, collectively, a hilly region.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk jamak kata bahasa Inggeris hill, yang bermaksud bukit atau kawasan berbukit; padanan bahasa Melayunya ialah bukit atau bukit-bukit mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: 属于英语词形；出现在马来语语料中时，可能是语码转换、引文或专名的一部分，不能仅凭词频判为正式马来语词。以下搭配为英语搭配，ms 字段保留其原形。[Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/hill)

etymology.historical_story: English hill descends from Old English hyll, a Germanic landscape word. Hills is its ordinary plural, rather than a Malay derivative. When it appears inside Malay conversation, the useful distinction is between an English insertion and the Malay equivalent bukit. Its presence alone does not establish a separate Malay borrowing. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=hill)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记英语 hill /hɪl/ 是一座小山；尾巴加 /z/，hills 就是多座山丘。马来语对应 bukit；这是形态记忆法，不是马来语词源。
